research_question: Is the current adjusted multivariate Portmanteau h=12 gate size-calibrated in the platform's finite-sample VAR setting, and, only if it is not, does a preregistered multivariate BG LM or Edgerton-Shukur small-sample F diagnostic satisfy the same calibration gate?
anti_test_shopping_statement: Actual-country pass counts, actual-country p-values, IRF availability, and higher-lag diagnostic alternatives are prohibited inputs to test selection. The candidate list, thresholds, tie-breaker, designs, and seed namespace are frozen before simulation.

candidate_tests.definition: Q_h_star = T^2 * sum_{j=1}^h trace(C_j' C_0^-1 C_j C_0^-1)/(T-j)
candidate_tests.implementation_policy: Preserve the current production definition exactly; research code may independently reproduce it but may not alter src/lib/varEngine.ts.
references: Lutkepohl 2005, New Introduction to Multiple Time Series Analysis, section 4.4.3

candidate_tests.definition: LM_h = T * (K - trace(Sigma_R^-1 Sigma_e)), where Sigma_R and Sigma_e are restricted and residual-lag-augmented auxiliary-system covariance estimates using a common auxiliary sample.

references: Edgerton and Shukur 1999, Testing autocorrelation in a system perspective

null_DGPs: stable K=3 VAR(p) with iid multivariate Gaussian innovations
stable K=3 VAR(p) with iid multivariate t(5) innovations scaled to the Gaussian covariance
alternative_DGPs: common residual AR(1) persistence rho_u in {0.10,0.20,0.35}
single-equation-dominant residual AR(1) persistence rho_u in {0.10,0.20,0.35}

simulation_layers.A: true lag p is fixed and estimated at the same p; isolates diagnostic-statistic calibration
simulation_layers.B: current common-sample BIC, maximum-lag policy, and parameter-ratio gate are applied before the diagnostic; evaluates the joint platform procedure

random_seed_namespace.parallel_policy: Each design and replication range receives an explicit SeedSequence spawn key; fork-inherited RNG is prohibited.

size_acceptance_rule.primary_key_cell_definition: T in {120,132,144}; K=3; true p in {1,2}; deterministic spec in {constant,constant_plus_11_month_dummies}; Gaussian iid innovations; persistence target in {0.5,0.8,0.95}; evaluated separately for Layer A and Layer B
eligible_for_gate_selection_requires_bot: every primary key cell rejection rate <= 0.075
at least 90 percent of primary key cells within 0.035 to 0.065

selection_rule: If current pt_adjusted passes the system-level size gate, retain it regardless of BG or ES real-data implications or power.
Only if pt_adjusted fails the system-level size gate may BG and ES be evaluated as replacement candidates.
A replacement candidate must pass the identical system-level size gate.
If both BG and ES pass, select the test with smaller worst-case absolute size distortion from 0.05.
If that worst-case distortion difference is less than 0.005, choose ES as the preregistered small-sample-correction tie-breaker.
If no eligible replacement exists, retain formal dynamic-response unavailability and make no production change.
real_data_application_rule: Phase A stops after reference validation, synthetic simulation calibration, method decision, and owner report. No new diagnostic may be applied to actual-country baselines without explicit owner approval for Phase B.
research_stop_rule: Stop after the preregistered Phase A method decision and owner report. Do not modify production readiness, activate IRFs, refit country models, change BIC lags, add tests, or begin IRF uncertainty research.
country_calibrated_stress_rule: May be considered only after the selection decision is frozen; it is not planned for Phase A and cannot alter method selection.

reference_policy.R_stack: R plus vars 1.6-1 and recorded dependency versions
reference_policy.R_role: reference fixtures and cross-language verification only

phase_A_prohibitions: lag reselection to obtain a diagnostic pass
